ClaimText: - AX-002 — Observations grant no authority. This is stated three times in the accepted sources — in `SOW-064`'s `Notes`, in `PRD.md` §12 ("grants no authority and changes no accepted scope without human approval"), and in `C16` ("observed friction routes to evidence-linked candidates and human gates") — and it is the value most at risk in a deliverable whose content is observations about how the work is going.
